guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: As of November 2, 2026, Waystar provides the following guidance for its full fiscal year 2026.1
•Total revenue is expected to be between $1.277 billion and $1.287 billion
•Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be between $543 million and $549 million
•Non-GAAP net income is expected to be between $322 million and $337 million
•Diluted non-GAAP net income per share is expected to be between $1.63 and $1.71
